wylie: rnam par thar pa brgyad ni nang la gzugs can du 'du shes pa ma bshig par phyi rol gyi gzugs la lta ba dang, nang la 'du shes de bshig nas phyi rol gyi gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar gnyis ni, sprul pa la gegs byed pa'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po'o
english: Within the eight types of freedom, we have the freedom where we look at outer forms without having disassembled our conceiving of things possessed of form on the inside. And then we have the freedom where we look at outer forms after having disassembled this conception about the inside. These two types of freedom then act as antidotes for obstacles which block our ability to emanate ourselves.
